description: EXAMPLE ONLY -- illustrates the fintr_study_spec_v1 schema; not a recommendation and not a validated finding. Combines two conditions: a rise in the total custody lot count of an example named custodian-code set over a 5-server-date lag, AND the AKD-derived VWAP proxy sitting notably above that day's close. The custody_change feature measures only the named codes given in params; it does not itself verify any 'foreign custodian' classification -- that label would need an independently sourced, verified custodian directory, which this tooling does not have.
